ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — companion registry authored 2026-09-05 from the RATIFIED KG Layer 3 section of the AIVIA Design Document (protocol step 2). The doc is the authority; any doc change updates this registry in the same breath. All build deferred by the phase ruling.
NOT regenerable — human judgment + gated machine output existing nowhere else; append-only; backed-up asset.

Spine.Definition: >=1 target: KG1/KG2 node or layer-3 citizen
declared per class only where authorship cannot say it; only description declares one
record time / event time (batch imports may differ)
version -> predecessor; nothing edited in place; version NUMBER derived (chain depth)
input version stamps: witness chain + staleness trigger
human iff any human-authored version OR accepting disposition; one-way by construction
machine iff author edge targets an agent identity

Classes.Payload: text; status: gate_passed | skeleton_floor | flagged (machine) / authored implicit (human)
Classes.Notes: kill accounting + absence rule live in the GENERATION-RUN EVENT
no status; standing derived from dispositions
HUMAN-ONLY — machines never rule; machine findings are lenses

Classes.Payload: action: asked|ran|confirmed; asked carries OUTCOME (matched|ambiguous|no-match); no about edge on no-match; inquiry text as payload post phi_gate
Classes.Notes: RULING APPLIED at conversion: register H5 CLOSED 2026-09-05 (asked carries outcome; no about on no-match). relied_on cut stands.

Classes.Payload: entra object id (key), kind: person|role|agent, display name, status

Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: no in-place edit path exists; summaries (ownership, authorship, version, standing, findings) have no stored field
pipeline cannot supersede-as-current a human-owned artifact; dispositions reject agent authors
generation-run event per run; shipped ⊎ absent = attempted; no empty-shell artifacts
writer census: descriptions<-generation, dispositions<-human surface, usage<-ask surface, proposals<-bridge
classes/edges/closed sets validate; identity edges resolve

Fixture_Families.Cases: machine chain -> human edit -> pipeline append renders proposed; certify-without-edit flips too
two rulers, conflicting dispositions -> disagreement state with names, no winner
superseding chains; current derived; version = depth
a run with ships, kills, and absences -> event accounting exact

Lifecycle.Writer / trigger: per class: descriptions+nominations <- generation pipeline (agent identity); dispositions <- human surface (HUMAN ONLY); usage <- ask surface; proposals <- bridge; human-authored terms/responsibilities <- human surface
Lifecycle.Postconditions: spine complete (about resolves any lower-or-same layer; author -> identity node; basis on machine versions; status in closed vocab); machine text gated; total gate failure -> NO artifact + run-event accounting
Lifecycle.Tests: LC3-C1 per class authored input -> authored artifact · LC3-C2 gate failure -> absence + counted · LC3-C3 disposition w/ agent author -> refused

Lifecycle.Writer / trigger: state-shaped only; same writers; humans via the human surface
Lifecycle.Postconditions: new version + supersedes edge; machine append on human-owned renders PROPOSED, never current
Lifecycle.Tests: LC3-S1 human edit -> ownership flips (derived) · LC3-S2 machine append on human-owned -> proposed · LC3-S3 events never supersede (no path)

Lifecycle.Writer / trigger: NOBODY — the action does not exist in this layer; ending is done BY WRITING (revoking disposition, superseding version)

Lifecycle.Postconditions: machine dispositions (LC3-F1) · pipeline current over human-owned (LC3-F2) · in-place edit (LC3-F3) · ANY deletion (LC3-F4 — absolute; PHI tension recorded as H6, SAFETY pass owes reconciliation) · empty shells (LC3-F5)

Governance_Overlay.Definition: twin-graph ruling (2026-09-06) 2f: kg3_artifacts + kg4_concepts merge into KG3, the governance overlay — one Governance_Layer_Registry. Doc is authority.

keeping its four ratified rules (human-mint-only, append-only, nameless — the term carries the name, basis snapshot); a concept's about-edges target a SET of meaning anchors (the family, by content_key)
about targets a MEANING IDENTITY — a KG2b content_key at a scope path, or a KG1 object — never a KG2a syntax node, never a node instance
same content_key after regeneration -> the artifact survives silently (was a rule)
changed content_key -> flagged orphan (the drift finding); deleted scope -> orphaned with similarity candidates (was a rule)
syntax-only churn (reformat, alias rename) costs zero governance
